name: WPA Social and Messenger Security Policy
purpose: Protect WPA and its creator from account takeover, impersonation, synthetic-media abuse, unauthorised publishing, reputational misconduct and unsafe community behaviour across official social networks, public channels, groups and messaging services.
scope: future WeChat, VK, twinme, Webex and other approved channels

security_objectives.account_integrity: Prevent unauthorised access, credential theft and silent privilege expansion.
security_objectives.identity_integrity: Make official WPA channels and creator-controlled statements distinguishable from impersonation and synthetic media.
security_objectives.content_integrity: No official release without attributable human authorisation and traceable source context.
security_objectives.community_integrity: Harassment, threats, hate, sexual misconduct, doxxing, fraud, impersonation, spam and abusive behaviour are not permitted in WPA-governed spaces.
security_objectives.incident_resilience: Contain, document, report, correct and recover from security or impersonation incidents quickly.

authentication: Use a unique password for every platform.
Enable the strongest available two-factor authentication; prefer authenticator app, passkey or hardware security key over SMS where the platform supports it.
Store recovery codes offline in a controlled location.
Do not share passwords, one-time codes, recovery codes, QR login secrets or session tokens.
Review active sessions and signed-in devices regularly and revoke anything unrecognised.
admin_and_roles: Grant admin or moderator rights only to named trusted persons with a defined need.
Any new admin, owner, publisher or moderator role requires Human Gate approval.
Remove stale or unused roles promptly.
publishing: No automatic publishing unless a platform-specific official adapter, credential scope, security review and Human Gate mandate are separately approved.
High-impact statements, crisis communication, corrections, personal statements attributed to the creator, and sensitive video/audio releases require explicit human review before publication.
Where practicable, retain the original source file, creation date, approved caption and final published URL for important media.
device_and_browser: Keep operating system, browser and platform apps updated.
Use device screen lock and full-disk encryption where available.
Avoid account administration from shared or public computers.
Do not approve unexpected login prompts or QR-login requests.
Treat browser extensions with account access as privileged software and keep the set minimal.

synthetic_media_and_impersonation.rule: No video, audio, image, quote or statement should be treated as an official statement of Sande Smiljanov or WPA merely because it visually or audibly resembles them.
synthetic_media_and_impersonation.official_source_rule: Authoritative confirmation should come from an official WPA channel listed in the canonical registry or another creator-controlled verified source.
deepfake_response: Preserve evidence: URL, account name, timestamps, screenshots and, where lawful, the file itself.
Do not publicly amplify the synthetic or impersonating content more than necessary for correction.
Report the content and impersonating account through the platform's impersonation, manipulated-media, harassment or fraud process as applicable.
Publish a concise correction from an official WPA channel when the false content creates material reputational or public confusion.
Cross-reference the canonical official-channel registry so audiences know where authentic WPA statements appear.
Escalate threats, extortion, identity theft, coordinated harassment or other potentially criminal conduct to the appropriate competent authorities or legal counsel.
synthetic_media_and_impersonation.provenance_principle: For important original media, preserve source provenance and publication records. Provenance supports verification but does not by itself guarantee that external copies cannot be manipulated.

prohibited: impersonation or false claims of speaking for WPA or its creator
hate or degrading conduct based on protected characteristics
sexual harassment or sexually abusive conduct
doxxing or publication of private personal data
fraud, phishing, credential solicitation or malicious links
spam, coordinated manipulation or deceptive promotion
knowingly fabricated media presented as authentic
attempts to obtain private credentials or security information
community_conduct.moderation_rule: WPA-governed groups and channels may remove content, restrict participation, block accounts and preserve evidence when behaviour violates this policy or platform rules.
community_conduct.human_gate: Material bans, public accusations, legal-risk claims and reputational corrections should receive attributable human review.

severity_levels.S1: spam, nuisance or isolated misconduct with no account compromise
severity_levels.S2: credible impersonation, abusive campaign or suspicious login without confirmed takeover
severity_levels.S3: confirmed account takeover, unauthorised publishing, credential exposure, synthetic-media campaign causing material harm or coordinated targeted abuse
severity_levels.S4: threats to physical safety, extortion, serious identity theft, significant data exposure or other emergency-level incident

first_actions: Contain access: change the affected platform password from a trusted device and revoke unknown sessions where possible.
Remove unauthorised admins, apps, integrations or forwarding rules.
Preserve evidence before deleting malicious posts when safe and lawful.
Use the platform's official recovery and reporting mechanisms.
Issue a correction from a known-good official WPA channel if the public may have been misled.
Record the incident, actions taken and recovery status.
incident_response.fail_closed_rule: If account control, identity, authorship or publishing authority is uncertain, pause official publication from that platform until control is re-established.

operational_limits: This policy reduces risk but cannot guarantee that hacking, impersonation, deepfakes or abusive behaviour will never occur.
WPA systems do not currently have direct security control over external social-platform infrastructure.
Automated continuous monitoring or takedown is not claimed unless a lawful, authorised and technically verified integration is separately activated.
Security features differ by platform and must be configured inside each external account.
